title: Message Types
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
The corresponding data elements in SAP S/4HANA are:

e Items: OPBEL + OPUPW + OPUPK

e Splitltems: OPUPZ

Note that in the FI-CA backend a cleared Splitltem always points to its clearing document, whereas in the message structure the
cleared Splitltem always points to the payment or credit memo that cleared it.

Message Types

e ContractAccountERPReceivablesPayablesRegisterltemBylDQuery_sync

e ContractAccountERPReceivablesPayablesRegisterltemBylDResponse_sync

Constraints

In case invoices have been partially cleared by payments in other currencies, errors may occur when you display the partial
amounts of the invoices.

Notes on SAP Implementation
Prerequisites
You are using software component FI-CA (as of version FI-CA 6.02).

You have maintained the backend configuration of SAP Biller Direct in FI-CA (see Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable
and Payable under Integration -> Financial Supply Chain Management -> Biller Direct -> Basic Setting for Customer Portal in
Internet ).

The user has sufficient authorizations, in particular with regard to the authorization object F_KK_EBPP.
Processing

FI-CA event 6607 is called directly after inbound mapping of the service is done; it can be used to modify the query fields before
the business logic is performed.

FI-CA event 6608 is called before the response message is returned to the service consumer; it can be used to modify the
response fields and to handle customer extensions carried out in the service interface

FI-CA event 6600 can be used to map an external contract account ID to the internal contract account ID.

More Information

For information on corrections and frequently asked questions relating to this operation, refer to SAP Note 1063631 (collective
note).
